environment.conditions: App window frequently occluded or minimised; timings were taken in that state and may be pessimistic or optimistic. Not a phone.

input: Synthetic pictures drawn on a canvas (a gradient with a skin-coloured block). No camera, hand or person was involved, so every picture had zero hands and the palm detector ran on each one.
findings: Tracker time does not depend on picture width (run 3, interleaved, identical content): a smaller picture buys no speed, so the width ladder was removed and the width is fixed at 640.
The first inference after start can take about 1 second (run 1).
Roughly 8 to 14 pictures per second reached the tracker on this laptop in this state. The busy-drop rule keeps delay bounded at that rate. Phones are expected to be slower and are untested.
A wrong-session picture returned a non-fatal error carrying its sequence number, and the page's bitmap was transferred (detached) to the worker.

close was acknowledged in 203 ms (idle), 7 ms (after 5 frames) and 48 ms (after 60 frames). One earlier close acknowledgement was not received within 8 s and could not be reproduced in three retries. The session does not depend on it: it terminates the worker itself.

uiCheck.action: Pressed Start on the real panel while this pane's camera permission was 'denied' (checked immediately before).
uiCheck.result: Panel moved to 'denied' with the plain-language message; no stream was attached; asset loading was cancelled before any worker was created.

notTested: A real camera, a real hand or any signer
Hand detection quality, hand-face contact, motion blur, low light
Phones and tablets, thermal behaviour over time
Screen readers and keyboard-only use of the panel
Tab hidden / page hide in a real browser (covered by unit tests with fakes)
